! device: edge-router (cEOS)
!
hostname edge-router
logging host 10.10.0.99
ntp server 10.10.0.99
banner login
Authorized access only.
EOF
!
enable secret 5 $1$salt$3xampleOneWayHashValue0
!
management ssh
   no shutdown
!
management telnet
   shutdown
!
snmp-server community s3cr3t-r0nly ro
!
interface Ethernet1
   description access-user-port
   switchport mode access
   switchport nonegotiate
   spanning-tree bpduguard enable
   switchport port-security
!
line vty 0 31
   transport input ssh
   ip access-class MGMT-IN in
!
end
